name: desk_accepted_only_sensitivity
axes: X right (left negative), Y forward/depth, Z up (down negative)
convention: Column vectors. p_kinect_radar_axes = R @ p_radar + t. Axes convention is shared; origins/orientations are calibrated.
kinect_axis_conversion: [x_native, z_native, -y_native]; apply to all Kinect positions before the convention-matched transform
application: For native Kinect SDK points in mm: divide by 1000, then use native_kinect_to_radar_4x4 directly. Do not also reorder axes when using that native-input matrix.
warnings: Rigid least squares with equal weight per placement; no scale, range bias or radar phase-centre model.
Fit residuals measure agreement on fitting points, not independent calibration accuracy.
Fixed sensor mounting across sessions is assumed from the requested collection and saved protocol attestations.
kinect points are approximately planar; little height diversity is available.

session_snapshot.name: desk_front_1
session_snapshot.mounting_state: Unverified; confirm fixed rig and target separately for each paired label

radar.axes: X lateral, Y forward, Z up

processing.axes: x lateral, y forward, z up; no mounting transform
processing.power_units: ADC_count_squared; dB re 1 ADC_count_squared (not dBm, RCS or SNR)
processing.method: coherent loop mean, normalized Blackman FFT, normalized 12-channel Bartlett; average power across frames
processing.caveat: Grid spacing is not spatial resolution. Physical signs and reflector localization need hardware validation.

kinect.axes: X right, Y down, Z forward
kinect.aggregation: temporal median at one depth pixel; spread is repeatability, not accuracy

protocol.geometry_notes: Front annulus on cap; cap seats at aperture; nominal 55 mm orthogonal facets and 2.4 mm plate. Radar phase centre not modelled. Centre marking ray intersected with fitted front plane, then shifted inward along each frame normal.

cap_geometry.assumptions: Front annulus on cap; cap seats at aperture; nominal 55 mm orthogonal facets and 2.4 mm plate. Radar phase centre not modelled.

original_pair.offset_definition: reference_xyz = selected_xyz + offset_xyz, separately in each native sensor frame
original_pair.note: Acceptance records user attestations, not measured calibration accuracy. Fit/export uses the separate calibration tool.
